_comment: One entry per camera view. id: also its node in the exit graph (app/exit_router.py) unless graph_node is set.
source: rtsp:// URL or a video file path relative to the repo root. rtsp://localhost:8554/<name> is the clip
data/india_dataset/raw_videos/<name>.mp4 replayed by MediaMTX (or read directly with FRAME_SOURCE=local).
roi: walkable-area polygon in camera pixels [[x, y], ...]; null = whole frame.
Persons/m2 needs either area_m2 (rough ground area of the ROI) or calibration:
{"image_points": [[x, y] x4+], "ground_points": [[X_m, Y_m] x4+]} from measured floor markers (plan 4.5).
The clip names and area_m2 values below are placeholders until the clips are chosen and measured.
